mapper.select:
select t.team_id, t.team_name , t.profile_image, t.skill, t.sport, t.gender, t.region1, t.region2, t.region3, t.age_20s, t.age_30s, t.age_40s, t.age_50s, t.age_60_plus, t.day_mon, t.day_tue, t.day_wed, t.day_thu, t.day_fri, t.day_sat, t.day_sun, t.time_06_09, t.time_09_12, t.time_12_18, t.time_18_22, t.time_22_06, ( select count(*) from team_user tu where tu.team_id = t.team_id and tu.withdrawn = false ) as current_people from team t WHERE COALESCE(t.deleted, false) = false
AND t.sport IN
#{sport}
AND ( t.gender = #{gender} OR t.gender = '성별 무관' )
t.day_mon = true
t.day_tue = true
t.day_wed = true
t.day_thu = true
t.day_fri = true
t.day_sat = true
t.day_sun = true
AND t.skill IN
#{skill}
AND (
( t.region1 = #{region} OR t.region2 = #{region} OR t.region3 = #{region} )
)
AND ( t.team_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY current_people DESC
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
limit #{offset}, 12

select t.team_id, t.team_name, t.profile_image, t.description, t.skill, t.sport, t.gender, t.region1, t.region2, t.region3, t.age_20s, t.age_30s, t.age_40s, t.age_50s, t.age_60_plus, t.day_mon, t.day_tue, t.day_wed, t.day_thu, t.day_fri, t.day_sat, t.day_sun, t.time_06_09, t.time_09_12, t.time_12_18, t.time_18_22, t.time_22_06, t.activity_image1, t.activity_image2, t.activity_image3, t.activity_image4, t.activity_image5, ( select count(*) from team_user tu where tu.team_id = t.team_id and tu.withdrawn = false ) as current_people from team t where t.team_id = #{teamId} and COALESCE(t.deleted, false) = false
